name: protocol_golden_m4
description: The GDScript codec decodes every message of the M4 golden transcript (a dev match's resilience recorded from the Python server: a checkpoint uploaded, RESYNC for a desync, a rejoin and a tab behind, ERROR 12, desynced_twice and no_held_seat) into the listed values, and encodes each back to the same bytes.

steps.msg: all 93 records decode and re-encode byte for byte
the transcript speaks this game's protocol version
the checkpoints, their parts both ways and the three RESYNCs are in

steps.assert: report['types']['VISIBILITY'] == 4 and report['types']['ERROR'] == 1 and report['types']['NOTICE'] == 1 and report['types']['MATCH_END'] == 1
steps.msg: the visibility states, the replaced link, no_held_seat and desynced_twice are in
